candidates.name: NASA insignia
candidates.description: NASA’s protected agency insignia appears on hardware, screens, apparel, and the closing card.
candidates.excerpt: NASA archival footage follows: the Space Launch System, Orion, agency identifiers, and workers preparing the launch vehicle.
candidates.usage_note: Repeated agency identifier within sourced footage and graphics.
candidates.production_impact: Confirm that the intended factual use follows NASA identifier and non-endorsement guidance.

candidates.name: Artemis mission identity
candidates.description: The Artemis wordmark and mission identity bookend the recap and appear throughout the launch material.
candidates.excerpt: The ARTEMIS mission identity resolves over the lunar surface.
candidates.usage_note: Featured mission identifier in opening and closing graphics.
candidates.production_impact: Treat the mission identity separately from the underlying government footage.

candidates.name: Launch Pad 39B
candidates.description: NASA’s launch complex and Kennedy Space Center facilities are named and prominently depicted.
candidates.excerpt: The Space Launch System and Orion spacecraft stand live on Launch Pad 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center.
candidates.usage_note: Named federal facility shown through NASA-supplied archival material.
candidates.production_impact: Distinguish use of existing public footage from a request to film on NASA property.

candidates.name: NASA Artemis I launch footage
candidates.description: The rough cut incorporates NASA-produced launch, mission-control, spacecraft, and animation footage.
candidates.excerpt: NASA launch footage follows the rocket away from the pad and into the night sky.
candidates.usage_note: Substantial use of a specific NASA Image and Video Library asset.
candidates.production_impact: Record the exact source asset, attribution, intended use, and any third-party notices.

candidates.name: Bill Nelson
candidates.description: Bill Nelson appears on camera and is identified by name and former NASA title.
candidates.excerpt: BILL NELSON, identified on screen as NASA Administrator, speaks at a podium.
candidates.usage_note: Identifiable person, voice, name, and official title.
candidates.production_impact: Commercial or promotional reuse may require separate privacy/publicity review.

candidates.name: European Space Agency
candidates.description: The European Service Module is named and depicted as part of Orion.
candidates.excerpt: Orion flies above Earth and the Moon. The European Service Module is named and shown as part of the spacecraft.
candidates.usage_note: Named international agency contribution and spacecraft hardware.
candidates.production_impact: Confirm attribution and whether any ESA-supplied material carries separate terms.

candidates.name: Mission score
candidates.description: A continuous documentary score is called for beneath narration and broadcast audio.
candidates.excerpt: A musical score continues beneath the official broadcast audio.
candidates.usage_note: Generic score cue; the exact composition and recording are not identified in the captions.
candidates.production_impact: Obtain a cue sheet or confirmation that the soundtrack is included in the reusable NASA asset.
